finding: ⭐ THE MAPPING IS DETERMINED BY THE GRAPH, NOT CHOSEN BY THIS CYCLE, and that was verified rather than taken from the item: all three ids are absent from the 77 routes in routes.json, and each target is the `primary` route for the publication those rows name — RT-ASO (primary, PUB-ASO) NOT RT-ASO-ASK (contributing, the wet-lab ask); RT-PARTNER-STRAT (primary, PUB-FUSION-PARTNER); RT-DEGRADER (primary, PUB-DEGRADER). ★ THE HARM WAS REAL AND MEASURED: four rows could never be scored at all, because apply_route_inheritance gives an unscored row the floor OF ITS ROUTE and a route the graph lacks has no floor. After the remap they inherit 71.71, 70.86, 70.86 and 35.71 — AUT-PD-006, AUT-PD-040 and AUT-PD-141 are ASO v2 manuscript and gate work, AUT-PD-005 is degrader-paper work. That coupling is the good kind — it means a repair that shrinks the population is forced to re-pin, so the constant can only ever tighten by neglect, never loosen.
